MaldocTrace: open-source triage for malicious Office documents.

It emulates VBA and Excel 4.0 macros in a simulated Windows environment (nothing is executed) and reports the commands, decoded payloads and IOCs, each traced to the module and line that produced it.

Single static binary for Windows, Linux and macOS, Apache-2.0.

https://github.com/debugactiveprocess/MaldocTrace

#BlueTeam #DFIR #MalwareAnalysis #ThreatHunting #InfoSec #OpenSource
